meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes and a client call at 4:40, so let's start with why my son learned about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
"Cheated." I'm writing that word down, Hale, and the time you said it. You say you can prove it, so put it on the table, because so far you've said it and shown me nothing.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
"Pasted." You can't see pasting, Hale, you can see two edits, and Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend. Turn the screen so I can read the timestamps myself.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.
You skipped past turning the screen, Hale, and I noticed. Read me the line, word for word, the way it's in his essay.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My son does not lie to me, and I'd be very careful calling him a liar to my face. You've had three chances to put a document in front of me and you've taken none of them, so either read me that line or I'm finishing this conversation in the principal's office.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it." That rewrite isn't your gift to offer, Hale, it's in your own procedure, section 4.4, the same procedure whose section 4.2 you broke when you entered that zero without calling me. Is anything on Owen's record right now, yes or no?
I asked you a question, Hale, and I'm still waiting on it. Is anything on his record, yes or no?
